This distinction drives nearly every subtlety in the checker.

State progression tracks the longest suffix of the input seen so far that is also a prefix of `1101`. From suffix `1`, a `1` advances to suffix `11`; a `0` falls back to idle (since `10` is not a prefix). From suffix `11`, a `1` advances to suffix `110`; a `0` falls back to idle.
